name: Yuuki Nao
source:
Likes: [url=/c13808]Her Nii-san[/url], meat.
Dislikes: Insects, reptiles.
Hobbies: Eating, taking naps.

She can't live without her brother's cooking and so when Misaki takes him away from her she proposes to marry him so that they can continue to live together as his fiancée.
